verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak layout: the original full-bleed photo becomes a small inset on plain white, the second exercise photo shrinks to an unreadable thumbnail, and the yellow accent shapes no longer frame the headline. Instead they float over the photo as random blocks. In A, two horizontal yellow bars cover the gym background beside the woman. In B, a larger yellow bracket covers even more of the photo and looks heavier and more arbitrary, so A is slightly less damaging. The headline and name bars stay legible in both, but the brand's energetic, layered feel is lost.
